title: 2026 proposed international-maritime IMO interaction QA controls

sources.title: International maritime voyages consultation accessible webpage
UK ETS scope expansion: emissions from international maritime voyages

facts.source_fact: Adoption of the IMO Net Zero Framework was delayed in October 2025.
The UK intends to continue working toward development and adoption of the IMO framework.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat the delayed framework as abandoned.

facts.source_fact: The consultation proposes UK ETS action while IMO adoption is delayed.
The Authority plans to review UK ETS interaction with the IMO framework after adoption.
The Authority also plans to consider future EU ETS changes in that review.
The proposal aims to cover 50% of international-voyage emissions.
Combined UK and EU ETS coverage is expected to cover 100% of emissions on UK-EEA voyages under the proposal.
facts.expected_handling: Label as expected policy effect, not measured outcome.

facts.source_fact: The consultation recognises operator concerns about administrative burden.
The international proposal is expected to increase the proportion of emissions covered for operators already in domestic scope.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer new operator count from emissions coverage.

facts.source_fact: The precise interaction of UK ETS, EU ETS and IMO measures remains subject to review.
facts.expected_handling: Block certainty beyond published policy status.
